about_the_game:
Rogue's Tale - Expertise is the fourth expansion for Rogue's Tale.

It adds new joinable guilds and expertise talents to learn while completing jobs for your chosen guild. Expertise talents combine two or more normal talents into one while also freeing up talent points for additional talents.

There are four different guilds, Fighters, Hunters, Wizards and Thieves, and joining a guild gives you access to a guild vendor, trainer and a job board. Each guild has 9 jobs to help you gain rank in your chosen guild and 3 talents to specialize your character.

The guild vendor sells items that become available as you advance the ranks and the guild trainer can teach you once all requirements are met.
